Use supplied project hero image ONLY as linework and soft cel-shading style reference, not as subject.

Bottom left ATTACK: sail leans decisively RIGHT, strong open-mouthed puff, tail trails to left, clearly distinct from telegraph, small confined wind wisps. Bottom right CURSE RELEASE: same intact kite floats softly upright with joyful closed eyes and smile, a handful of warm tiny light particles, relaxed tail; no destruction, wounds, blood or aggressive expression.
Uniform character scale and consistent diamond center near the center of each cell. Full tails visible, no ground shadows or environment. Crisp original webtoon linework and warm soft cel shading matching reference. No text, numbers, labels, watermarks, symbols resembling letters, border, weapons, extra characters. Transparent outer borders and empty horizontal/vertical cell seams. Square overall canvas.
